question: What great accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginīs through this practice?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are named together
A great accomplishment is the subject
This accomplishment becomes dear to yoginīs
inference: The practice yields a great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation dear to the yoginīs
uncertainties: Whether bhukti mukti forms a compound or a dvandva pair is not explicit
plain_english: A great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
